run_llama_baseline: run the LLaMA model baseline on an open-eqa dataset with --model-path and --dataset flags
run_llama_dry_run: run a dry run of the LLaMA baseline processing only the first 5 questions
ask_question_llama: ask a question to an LLaMA model using the ask_question function with a prompt template
parse_output_llama: parse the LLaMA model output string to extract the answer after the A: prefix
parse_args_llama: parse command line arguments for the LLaMA baseline including model path, temperature, and max tokens
